remarks: Completely renovated 5-bedroom, 4-bath home with a spacious addition, ideally located near Stamford Hospital and just minutes from downtown Stamford! This sun-filled property offers a flexible, modern layout with exceptionally large bedrooms and expansive living spaces throughout. Blending modern updates with timeless charm, the home features oversized rooms, updated finishes, and multiple generously sized bedrooms, including ensuite options that provide comfort, privacy, and versatility! The addition creates even more usable space-perfect for guests, extended living, or work-from-home needs. Enjoy the convenience of being close to downtown Stamford's dining, shopping, entertainment, and major commuting routes, all while living in a residential setting. A rare opportunity to own a turnkey home with hard-to-find bedroom sizes in a prime Stamford location!
